# WESCO Co., Ltd. — TSP® Voltage Sag Protection

> WESCO is a South Korean manufacturer established in 2001. TSP® (The Second POWER) uses EDLC supercapacitors for energy storage to protect connected industrial loads against brief voltage sags and momentary interruptions. Product selection and compensation capability depend on the model, load and operating conditions. WESCO serves semiconductor and display facilities as well as general manufacturing, including automotive and battery production.

The new multilingual introduction and installation series consists of AI-assisted educational reconstructions based on product references. These films are not customer-site footage or performance-test records. Earlier demonstration materials have their own context on their individual pages.

## Product scope
- TSP® means The Second POWER. Its compensation energy is stored in EDLC supercapacitors rather than conventional batteries.
- The basic connection is distribution panel → TSP INPUT → TSP OUTPUT → protected equipment. Protection concerns the connected load within the selected product's ratings, not every machine in a factory.
- The single-phase educational series covers equipment control power; the three-phase series covers the selected three-phase equipment/load. Selection depends on ratings, wiring arrangement and load conditions.
- Response time and compensation duration must be checked for the applicable model, load and supply conditions. The educational examples are not universal performance guarantees.
- Communications and SAG Viewer are optional. When configured, they support monitoring of events and waveforms.
- Battery-free compensation storage avoids periodic replacement of conventional storage batteries. Inspection, cleaning and component management still follow the applicable manual and operating environment; this is not a maintenance-free guarantee.
